resources.string: View today\'s push-ups, streak, and start a session in one tap.
Tap the circle or +1 button during sets.
Place phone face-up under chest; calibrates down-and-up motion.
Front camera tracks chest-shadow dips on device without proximity hardware.
Optional spoken rep & rest cues (off by default).
Alerts only on your chosen training days—automatically skipped if you already trained today.
Solo workouts, goals, schedules, and milestones stay locally on your device in Room (excluded from cloud Auto Backup unless you export a JSON backup).
Optional Front-Camera Optical Mode analyzes frame luminance in memory on-device only. No photos or video frames are ever saved or uploaded.
Optional Clubs use Google Sign-In and Cloud Firestore to sync your chosen nickname, club memberships, and aggregate push-up totals.
